Educational Rock and Mineral Collection Lot
Vintage Geology Specimen Sets
Mixed Materials, Approximately 10 Pieces, Vintage
This comprehensive lot features a variety of vintage educational rock and mineral collection kits, likely produced for classroom or home study use in the late 20th century. The collection includes themed sets such as "Native Rocks - Foundations of the Earth" and "Natural Commercial Minerals - The Basis of Industry," providing a wide-ranging overview of geological specimens categorized by their formation (igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary) and economic utility. These sets are highly sought after by geology enthusiasts and educators for their instructional value and nostalgic appeal.
Includes multiple "Native Rocks" and "Natural Commercial Minerals" clear plastic display cases with identified specimens
Features larger boxed sets with white plastic organizers and numbered specimens including obsidian, granite, and pumice
Accompanied by educational materials including the "Investigating the Rock Cycle" booklet and introductory guides

The majority of specimens are present and well-preserved within their respective housings. The clear plastic cases show typical signs of age, including surface scuffing and some hairline cracks. The internal white plastic tray is intact with specimens numbered for identification. Overall, the collection is in good vintage condition for display or study.
